title: Payment | AC Wallet Selected | Frozen Aeroplan | EAP Check Fail | Fallback to Cash | Interac |
description:
Customer has Aeroplan and selects AC Wallet, but EAP (E-credit Application Platform) check reveals the Aeroplan account is FROZEN (fraud hold / compliance issue). System must gracefully fall back to cash payment without alarming the customer.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TCED13; Aeroplan #: 1111222233 on booking; Aeroplan account status: FROZEN; 1 leg AC (YUL?YYZ); Delay 4 hrs; Code 42; APPR EL-01; Customer resides in Canada
